meta.title: Industries
meta.description: Italian equipment for plastics and packaging, food and beverage, industrial automation, precision engineering, construction materials and the automotive aftermarket in East Africa.

hero.title: Equipment for the sectors that drive East African industry.
hero.text: Six industries, each served by vetted Italian manufacturers and supported locally from Nairobi. Select one to see what we source.

items.name: Plastics and packaging
items.body: Kenya imported €117M of packaging machinery in 2024, up 11%, with Italy supplying 14.5% — third behind India and China. Italian packaging machinery is a €9B+ industry that exports around 80% of its output.

items.name: Food and beverage processing
items.body: Processing, filling and bottling equipment for food and beverage producers scaling up across Kenya and the region.

items.name: Industrial automation
items.body: Control systems, robotics and integration from Italian automation specialists, matched to existing production lines.

items.name: Precision engineering
items.body: CNC machining centres, tooling and components for fabricators and maintenance operations.

items.name: Construction materials
items.body: Plant and equipment for the construction materials sector across a fast-building region.

items.name: Automotive aftermarket
items.body: Workshop equipment and components for service, repair and parts businesses.

network.title: Our manufacturer network.
network.text: Every manufacturer is vetted on technical capability, capacity, quality and export readiness. The network spans six categories.

cta.title: Don't see your equipment listed?
cta.text: Tell us what you need. If it's built in Italy, we can usually find the right maker.
